title: Rabbi Chanina of Ono
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Mishnah, end of Gittin, chapter 6: “This halakhah Rabbi Chanina of Ono brought up from prison” (in the name of Rabbi Akiva, who was imprisoned — Rashi). In the Gemara there, 67a: “Rabbi Shimon son of Rabbi said before Rabbi: Since Rabbi Meir and Chanina of Ono disagree,” etc. In Sanhedrin 11b: “Chananyah of Ono testified that if they intercalated it in the Galilee, it is intercalated.” He is likewise mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 6:8.
